unknown.description: The location has not yet been classified.

collectible.description: A persistent acquisition, rescue, upgrade, or reward received by the player, regardless of whether it is found, purchased, earned, or granted.

boss.description: An individually tracked, non-respawning enemy formally considered a boss.

miniboss.description: An individually tracked, non-respawning enemy not formally considered a boss.

gauntlet.description: A combat challenge consisting of multiple enemies, waves, or an encounter as a whole rather than one individually tracked enemy.

enemy.description: An individually tracked enemy that respawns.

resource.description: A repeatable source of an item or currency tied to an area or spot. The resource opportunity, rather than a particular supplying enemy, is what the row represents.

switch.description: A triggerable physical or environmental actuator tracked independently for logic or room randomization.

blockade.description: A persistent, non-switch-controlled obstruction that can be removed or passed through an appropriate interaction.

lock.description: A persistent lock whose unlocking is itself the tracked location, normally requiring a key, currency, or another consumable.

bench.description: A bench or the persistent availability of a bench facility. It remains a Bench even when payment or another prerequisite is required.

travel.description: A travel-network access point or the persistent availability of a travel facility. It remains Travel even when payment or another prerequisite is required.

lore.description: A readable or inspectable world spot whose interaction conveys lore or knowledge rather than awarding a collectible.

event.description: A persistent progression or world-state milestone that has no more specific category.

logic-point.description: A virtual, geographically anchored reference used by logic. Reaching or using it does not inherently imply persistent state, an acquisition, combat completion, or a farmable resource.
